### Other ways to run it

1. Run it as published (BF16, needs ~8.83 GB, NVIDIA only, from [huggingface.co/BreezeBlue](https://huggingface.co/BreezeBlue/Breeze-TTS-2))
   
   ```sh
   git clone https://github.com/breezeblue-ai/breeze-tts.git && cd breeze-tts && python -m pip install -r requirements.txt && hf download BreezeBlue/Breeze-TTS-2 --local-dir ../breeze-tts-2 && python infer.py ../breeze-tts-2 --ref-audio ref.wav --ref-text 'Transcript of ref.wav' --text 'Hello world' --output out.wav
   ```

Other versions: BF16 (MLX-AUDIO 0.5.7) (~7.63 GB, Mac only) `pip install -U mlx-audio && mlx_audio.tts.generate --model mlx-community/Breeze-TTS-2-mlx --text "(sigh) Welcome aboard.
